brief: Dina muestra la oferta de práctica de un patrocinador: 1,000 monedas ahora o 1,300 en tres años. El aprendiz hace crecer el dinero de hoy en un fondo al 6% para comparar las dos ofertas en la misma fecha, ve cuánto cuesta aplazar una decisión con depósitos de 500 al mes, ordena razones para esperar y fija una fecha límite; al final decide en otro caso, la venta de una tableta.

mentor_misjudgment.misjudgment: Dina keeps postponing the fund choice until she knows more, so three monthly deposits of 500 coins sit idle for months.
mentor_misjudgment.recovery: Dina prices the wait, then says that next time she sets a decision date before she starts waiting.

regional.universal: Only LittleFounders coins and a pretend fund at a labelled rate; no market amounts, places or customs.

en-US.line: Take your time. First we measure both offers on the same day.

en-US.prompt: Step 1. Grow the 1,000 in a 6% pretend fund. Year 1 adds 6% of 1,000: 60.
en-US.line: Take your time: 1,000 plus 60 is 1,060 after year 1.

pt-BR.line: Com calma: 1.000 mais 60 são 1.060 ao fim do ano 1.

en-US.prompt: Step 2. Year 2: the 6% applies to 1,060, the new total. That adds 63.60.
en-US.line: Same move as year 1. The fund now holds 1,123.60.

es-MX.prompt: Paso 2. Año 2: el 6% se aplica a 1,060, el total nuevo. Eso suma 63.60.

en-US.prompt: Step 3. Year 3: 6% of 1,123.60 is 67.42, so the fund holds 1,191.02.
en-US.line: Same date, 1,300 beats 1,191. Waiting wins this time.
